title: Kurma Avatar: The Tortoise Who Held Up the World
sources: Bhagavata Purana, Canto 8, chapters 5-12 (Durvasa's curse, the churning of the ocean of milk with Mandara and Vasuki, Kurma, Halahala and Shiva, the treasures, Lakshmi, Dhanvantari, Mohini)
Vishnu Purana, Book 1, chapter 9, and Mahabharata, Adi Parva (Astika Parva): the Samudra Manthana

lines.text: Long ago, the gods lost their strength to a sage's curse,
lines.caps: LONG *AGO | THE *GODS | LOST THEIR *STRENGTH | TO A SAGE'S *CURSE

lines.text: and the demons began to win every battle.
lines.caps: AND THE *DEMONS | BEGAN TO *WIN | EVERY *BATTLE

lines.text: Desperate, they begged Vishnu for help, and he shared a secret.
lines.caps: *DESPERATE | THEY BEGGED *VISHNU | FOR *HELP | HE SHARED A *SECRET

lines.text: Churn the ocean of milk, and the nectar of immortality will rise.
lines.caps: *CHURN | THE OCEAN OF *MILK | AND THE *NECTAR | OF *IMMORTALITY | WILL *RISE

lines.text: The task was so huge that gods and demons had to work together.
lines.caps: THE TASK WAS SO *HUGE | GODS AND *DEMONS | HAD TO WORK *TOGETHER

lines.text: They used Mount Mandara as a churning rod,
lines.caps: THEY USED | MOUNT *MANDARA | AS A *CHURNING ROD
lines.say: They used Mount Mun-dara as a churning rod,

lines.text: and the serpent Vasuki as the rope.
lines.caps: AND THE *SERPENT | *VASUKI | AS THE *ROPE
lines.say: and the serpent Vah-sookee as the rope.

lines.text: with the gods at its tail, and the demons at its head.
lines.caps: THE *GODS | AT ITS *TAIL | THE *DEMONS | AT ITS *HEAD

lines.text: But as they pulled, the mountain began to sink.
lines.caps: BUT AS THEY *PULLED | THE *MOUNTAIN | BEGAN TO *SINK

lines.text: So Vishnu became Kurma, a giant tortoise,
lines.caps: SO VISHNU *BECAME | *KURMA | A GIANT *TORTOISE
lines.say: So Vishnu became Koorma, a giant tortoise,

lines.text: and dove beneath the waves to carry the mountain on his back.
lines.caps: AND *DOVE | BENEATH THE *WAVES | TO *CARRY | THE *MOUNTAIN | ON HIS *BACK

lines.text: Steady at last, the mountain spun, and the ocean foamed.
lines.caps: *STEADY | AT *LAST | THE MOUNTAIN *SPUN | THE OCEAN *FOAMED

lines.text: First came a deadly poison, dark enough to end the world,
lines.caps: FIRST CAME | A DEADLY *POISON | DARK *ENOUGH | TO END THE *WORLD

lines.text: but Shiva drank it, and his throat turned blue forever.
lines.caps: BUT *SHIVA | *DRANK IT | AND HIS *THROAT | TURNED *BLUE | *FOREVER

lines.text: Then the treasures rose. A wish granting cow, a white elephant, a tree of wishes, the shining moon,
lines.caps: THEN THE *TREASURES | *ROSE | A WISH GRANTING *COW | A WHITE *ELEPHANT | A *TREE | OF *WISHES | THE SHINING *MOON

lines.text: and Lakshmi, goddess of fortune, seated on a lotus.
lines.caps: AND *LAKSHMI | GODDESS OF *FORTUNE | SEATED ON A *LOTUS
lines.say: and Luckshmee, goddess of fortune, seated on a lotus.

lines.text: At last, the healer Dhanvantari appeared, holding the pot of nectar.
lines.caps: AT *LAST | THE *HEALER | *DHANVANTARI | APPEARED | HOLDING THE *POT | OF *NECTAR
lines.say: At last, the healer Dhun-vun-tuhree appeared, holding the pot of nectar.

lines.text: The demons snatched it,
lines.caps: THE DEMONS *SNATCHED IT

lines.text: but Vishnu, disguised as the enchanting Mohini, won it back for the gods.
lines.caps: BUT *VISHNU | *DISGUISED | AS THE ENCHANTING *MOHINI | *WON IT BACK | FOR THE *GODS
lines.say: but Vishnu, disguised as the enchanting Mo-hinee, won it back for the gods.

lines.text: Their strength returned, and the heavens were safe again.
lines.caps: THEIR *STRENGTH | *RETURNED | THE *HEAVENS | WERE *SAFE AGAIN

lines.text: And through it all, Kurma never moved.
lines.caps: AND THROUGH IT *ALL | *KURMA | NEVER *MOVED
lines.say: And through it all, Koorma never moved.

lines.text: This is Kurma, the second avatar of Vishnu,
lines.caps: THIS IS *KURMA | THE *SECOND | *AVATAR | OF *VISHNU
lines.say: This is Koorma, the second avatar of Vishnu,

lines.text: a reminder that the greatest strength is sometimes just holding steady.
lines.caps: A *REMINDER | THE GREATEST *STRENGTH | IS *SOMETIMES | JUST *HOLDING STEADY
